title: I've got a car! — inspection, IUC and insurance in one calendar
metaDesc: Type your plate, tap three buttons and get your car's year in your calendar: inspection, IUC road tax, insurance and service in Portugal. Free, no sign-up.
heroTitle: Your car has a whole year of deadlines
heroSub: Inspection, IUC, insurance, service. Type your plate — we do the rest.
plateNote: We don't store your plate: everything is calculated on your phone.
oldInspection: Over 8 years old — inspection every year.
yearHint: It's on the yellow strip of the plate or in the Certificado de Matrícula.
yearHintModern: It's in the Certificado de Matrícula (field B).
monthHint: That's your inspection month. In 2026 it's also your IUC month.
insHint: Check your policy or the insurer's e-mail.

rhythm.bi: Inspection every 2 years — next one in {y}

nothing12: Nothing in the next 12 months — your calendar will remind you later.
addCalHint: An .ics file with alerts for {n} years — iPhone, Android and Google.
calDone: Done! Open the file and choose “Add all”.
botText: We remind you before every deadline and send tips: wash the car before inspection, compare insurance.
consentMain: I agree to receive reminders and tips about my car. Only my contact and the months I chose are stored. I can unsubscribe at any time.
consentPartners: I'd also like offers from partners (car washes, garages).
shareText: Your car remembers for you: inspection, IUC and insurance in one calendar. Three taps:

tips.diesel: Diesel in town: now and then drive 20–30 minutes at a steady pace — the particulate filter will thank you.
tips.ev: Electric cars don't pay IUC. Also check the e-mobility support schemes.
tips.madeira: Madeira: salt and steep hills — check brakes and underbody once a year.
tips.acores: Azores: humidity and salt — watch for underbody corrosion.

ipo.d: Deadline: end of the month; you can go up to 3 months early. Bring the Certificado de Matrícula. Before going: wash the car and check the lights.

service.d: Oil, filters, brakes, tyres and lights. One garage visit gets you ready for next month's inspection.

iuc.t: IUC — pay by the end of the month
iuc.d: Portal das Finanças → IUC → issue payment document. Tip: direct debit means you never forget.

iucNew.d: From 2027 IUC is paid in April (amounts up to €100). Check amount and deadline on Portal das Finanças.

ins.d: Compare prices before renewing. No valid inspection, no insurance.

season.t: Get the car ready for winter
season.d: Tyres (1.6 mm minimum), battery, wipers and air conditioning.

renew.d: Generate the next years at seedwave.pt/carro

about.ipo: Periodic inspection: at 4 years, then every 2 years until 8, then every year — in the month of first registration.
about.iuc: IUC road tax: in 2026, by the end of the registration month; from 2027, in April.
about.ins: Insurance: a heads-up before renewal so you can compare prices.
about.svc: Service: the month before inspection — one garage visit for both.

honest: Rules checked in October 2026. When in doubt, Portal das Finanças and IMT have the final word.
